title: Cruise brief — Wed Sep 30, 2026
text: Carnival Corporation & plc reported fiscal Q3 2026 results Sep 29: revenue $8.44B (+3.5% YoY, beat), adjusted EPS $1.43 (beat), net income $1.92B, and record 2027 advance bookings alongside record customer deposits of $7.6B. CEO Josh Weinstein said "vacations are sacrosanct" even amid economic uncertainty, and the company raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to ~$2.24. Carnival CEO says vacation demand is defying economic angst (Benzinga); Cruise stocks rally as Carnival's Q3 results land (24/7 Wall St.). Separately, S&P Global lifted Carnival's credit rating to investment grade following the print. S&P Global upgrades Carnival rating on strong bookings (Investing.com)

title: Cruise brief — Wed Sep 30, 2026
text: [NCLH] NCL Corporation announced a proposed private offering of $750M in senior notes due 2031, aimed at redeeming its 6.125% notes due 2028 and paying down revolver and export-credit financing — a routine balance-sheet refinancing move. NCL Corporation announces proposed senior notes offering (GlobeNewswire) NCLH shares rose ~5% Tuesday purely in sympathy with Carnival's results, with no earnings of its own; some analysts trimmed price targets even as others stayed bullish on its luxury-brand strategy (Regent/Oceania).
